capabilities: Render live, auto-updating index blocks from moc code fences
Filter blocks with boolean, tag, regex and frontmatter date queries
Tick checkboxes in rendered blocks and sync them to source notes
Group, sort, limit, paginate and template rendered results
Bake dynamic blocks into static Markdown or copy them to clipboard
disambiguation: Not for hand-curated MOC pages; it generates indexes automatically from moc query blocks in a note.
extras: Full documentation lives outside the README (linked); a Create showcase command generates a demo folder with five ready-made dashboards.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to aggregate matching blocks from many notes into a self-updating index page, so MOCs must be maintained by hand.
summary: Dynamic Maps of Content generator that renders live, auto-updating index blocks of matching tasks, list items, headings, paragraphs or quotes from vault notes.
